name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn Halvorsen's path to motorsport was unconventional. Initially a promising physicist, he found himself drawn to the complex problem-solving inherent in race strategy during a university project analyzing telemetry data. This led him to abandon academia and pursue a career translating theoretical models into on-track advantages. 

Bjørn is known for his meticulous preparation and data-driven approach. He believes in building robust strategies that can adapt to unpredictable race conditions. While his technical understanding is solid, he excels at identifying opportunities where innovative thinking can provide a decisive edge. His demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to achieving optimal performance and a refusal to accept anything less than his team's best effort. His experience at Century Motorsport has helped him refine his innovative approach to race strategy.

Bjørn's dedication to finding that 'edge' has earned him a reputation as a strategist who can turn around difficult races. He combines a love for precision with an uncanny ability to see the big picture, making him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Bjørn is a man of medium height with a serious demeanor and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on drinking black coffee brewed exactly 30 minutes before each session.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
